name: scroll-expand
title: 滚动扩展 Scroll Expand
description: 将图片、视频或首屏从小画框滚动扩展到满屏，也可反向收拢。

props.name: children
props.description: Media or hero content that expands or collapses in the pinned viewport.

props.name: direction
props.description: Scroll direction of the visual transformation.

props.name: inset
props.description: Initial inset on every edge, as a percentage.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius at the compact state in pixels.

props.name: container
props.description: Scrollable element to observe instead of the page.

props.name: viewportClassName
props.description: Classes applied to the sticky viewport.

props.name: frameClassName
props.description: Classes applied to the transformed content frame.

usage: `ScrollExpand` 在指定滚动长度内固定一个视口，通过 `clip-path` 和内部缩放把媒体从留白画框展开到满屏。设置 `direction="collapse"` 可用于首屏缩小、圆角化退场的 Sticky Scale Hero 手法。
